draft.briefing: Hey, you're in Muzhappilangad! Your car can roll right onto the sand here, because this is a 4 km drive-in beach. In 2016 BBC Autos named it one of the six best beaches in the world for driving.
draft.hungryLine: Kannur food is classic Malabar, rice, biriyanis, puttu, appam and seafood, and look out for arikkadukka, stuffed mussels sold by local vendors.

moodReplies.show-me-around: Walk down to Muzhappilangad Beach, then drive up to Edakkad for another beach, and on to Kannur for St. Angelo's Fort.
moodReplies.somewhere-to-chill: Sit on the firm sand at Muzhappilangad Beach and watch the cars cruise along the shoreline.
moodReplies.surprise-me: Muzhappilangad is said to be the longest drive-in beach in India, with sand firm enough for cars.

spots.name: Muzhappilangad Beach
spots.detail: 6 min walk · 4 km of sand you can drive on

spots.name: Edakkad
spots.detail: Short drive · Another beach, on the Kannur side

spots.name: St. Angelo's Fort
spots.detail: In Kannur, 14 km away · Built by the Portuguese in 1505

legends.title: Thalappoli
legends.body: Muzhappilangad is famous for Thalappoli, a three-day ritual every March. It's held at the Sree Koormba Temple.

legends.title: A god without an idol
legends.body: There's no idol to worship at this temple, which has many legends. Instead, people worship through the Muthappan Theyyam, and Muthappan is believed to be a form of Lord Shiva.

tips.title: Come in March.
tips.body: That's when the three-day Thalappoli ritual takes over the Sree Koormba Temple.

tips.title: Check the beach before you drive.
tips.body: Muzhappilangad Beach is under major renovation, so ask locally about access.

story.title: The Portuguese arrive
story.body: The Portuguese built St. Angelo's Fort up the coast in Kannur. It still looks out over the sea.

story.title: Edakkad constituency
story.body: The Edakkad Assembly constituency was formed, replacing the old Cannanore-II seat.

story.title: New lines
story.body: After delimitation, Muzhappilangad became part of the new Dharmadam Assembly constituency.

story.title: World famous for driving
story.body: BBC Autos featured Muzhappilangad among the six best beaches for driving.

story.title: Hit the sand
story.body: Walk or drive the full 4 km and catch the sea breeze. Tell me how far you got.
